dct_description_sm: "The Electronic Map Library contains a number of digital maps portraying statistical census information for several metropolitan areas in the United States (as well as a national overview.) Most maps offer a demographic display of the following census categories: Population and Race, Citizenship, Income, Poverty, and Adult Educational Attainment. The site is particularly strong on Californian cities, but also includes some large cities in other states."--Home page.
Contributors: California State University, Northridge. Department of Geography.
Mode of access: World Wide Web.
